local_mode_depends_on_browser_storage_us: Local mode depends on browser almacenamiento. Usuarios should keep regular exports when datos loss would have significant consequences. Recovery cannot ser guaranteed para local datos removed por el browser o device.
practicora_provides_tools_to_document_in: Practicora provides tools a document prácticas, calculate horas, organize objetivos, analyze progreso y produce exports. El app does no replace official attendance, payroll, assessment o compliance systems used por un institución o employer.
the_foundation_may_evolve_be_interrupted: El foundation may evolve, ser interrupted o change functionality during desarrollo y beta. Future funciones shown on el Pricing página son no un commitment a availability o price.
these_terms_describe_the_current_demonst: These terms describe el actual demonstration foundation. Legal revisar para el operating jurisdiction y business model es obligatorio antes de public SaaS launch.
use_practicora_responsibly_and_in_accord: Use Practicora responsibly y en accordance con tu workplace.
users_must_follow_the_policies_of_their_: Usuarios debe follow el policies de their institución y práctica workplace. Practicora debe no ser used a store o share secrets, credentials, customer datos o content el usuario es no authorized a process.
users_remain_responsible_for_the_accurac: Usuarios remain responsible para el accuracy de dates, horas, descriptions y informes. Calculations y charts depend on supplied datos y debe ser reviewed antes de official submission.
when_a_cloud_account_is_enabled_users_mu: When un nube cuenta es activado, usuarios debe protect their password, verify their correo electrónico y informe unauthorized use. El local PIN solo protects el display de selected páginas on el device; it does no replace operating-system o Supabase cuenta seguridad.
metadata_description: Practicora terms para tracking, storing y exporting práctica datos.
